game.title: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands
game.blurb: Fantasy looter shooter where you roll a multiclass hero and quest to stop the Dragon Lord, from Gearbox Software, released 2022-03-25. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The campaign, told through hidden story milestones from Quest Get! onward. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Side Quests
chapters.summary: Twenty side quests, then every side quest.

chapters.title: The Overworld
chapters.summary: Dungeon Doors, encampments and stunning enemies that chase you on the Overworld map.

chapters.title: Chaos Chambers and Chaos Levels
chapters.summary: Chaos Chamber runs, Chaos levels 10 and 20, and unlocking every other achievement.

chapters.title: Levels, Loot and Party Play
chapters.summary: Hero levels, gold, inventory upgrades, Loot Luck, enchanting, cosmetics, lore scrolls, trading and reviving partners.

chapters.title: Later Hidden Achievements
chapters.summary: Eight hidden achievements listed after the rest, with low unlock rates. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Tiny Tina's Wonderlands" or "Tiny Tinas Wonderlands". There is no tinytinaswonderlands.fandom.com (HTTP 404); borderlands.fandom.com answers the API under "Tiny Tina's Wonderlands", with about 91 linked articles, including classes, "Chaos Mode", "Myth Ranks", "Achievement (Tiny Tina's Wonderlands)" and "Challenge (Tiny Tina's Wonderlands)"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Daffodil" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1286680. 22 of 47 Steam achievements are hidden. The first 14 hidden ones have high unlock rates (20.8 to 91.2%) and sit in the story chapter. The last 8 sit at the end of the Steam list, after "Bunker Mastered", with low rates (2.3 to 9.8%); they may be later added content, but the data does not say, so they have their own chapter. RAWG lists "Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep: A Wonderlands One-shot Adventure" (2021-11-09) as a separate game.
